title: AI Ethics & Human Impact Lead
description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. We are looking for an AI Ethics & Human Impact Lead to join our team. Reporting to the Head of People Risk & Integrity in the People & Culture organization, this position can be hybrid at our Santa Clara, CA headquarters or Bellevue, WA office or Remote with a preference for Chicago, IL based candidates. Sitting within the People Risk & Integrity (PRI) team, this leader will architect and drive our Ethical and Human Impact program, providing the independent judgment and ethical framework necessary to ensure our technological innovation remains fundamentally human-centered.  This is not a policy compliance role; it operates at the intersection of philosophy, technology and the future of work.  What you’ll do (Role Expectations) Develop and implement a comprehensive AI Ethics Framework for People systems and workforce-adjacent AI, defining our values and decision criteria Serve as an independent ethics authority with the mandate to pause, challenge, or escalate AI initiatives that pose unacceptable risks to employees or candidates Design and lead Human Impact Assessments (HIAs) for AI tools Articulate and maintain our ethical position on the purpose of AI in the workplace, balancing efficiency with human-centered innovation Monitor the evolving global regulatory landscape to ensure proactive compliance and strategic positioning Who You Are (Success Profile) You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, seeing dynamic and changing environments as an opportunity to construct something meaningful. You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, and you operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range. You possess the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. You are a high-trust partner. You thrive on collaborative feedback, matching ambition for the team with direct, respectful communication to build trust. What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) Advanced understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain An advanced degree or equivalent applied experience in a field requiring sustained ethical reasoning Deep practical literacy in how AI and machine learning systems work, sufficient to interrogate algorithmic design and identify risks Demonstrated subject matter expertise in AI ethics, responsible AI, technology policy, or organizational ethics Proven ability to exercise independent judgment and influence at the executive level with credibility and composure Exceptional ability to translate abstract ethical concepts into clear, actionable language for technical, legal, and business audiences What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency Direct experience building or leading an AI ethics or responsible technology function Specific experience with HR technology, people analytics, or workforce-related AI tools Background in labor economics, future of work research, or employment rights #LI-RL2 #LI-Hybrid  Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. title: Associate General Counsel, Ads Product
description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We’re looking for a highly motivated, technically savvy, and pragmatic attorney to join our Ads Legal team as Associate General Counsel, Ads Product. This role will provide legal guidance to our Ads Product and Engineering teams on a wide range of initiatives while collaborating with other partners across the company, including our commercial legal, ads policy, sales, privacy, and regulatory teams. This is an opportunity for an attorney who is mission-focused, proactive, and driven to make a big impact on Reddit’s rapidly growing ads business.  Location : Remote – United States (NYC/SF preferred but not required) What You’ll Do: Enable Product Growth: Leverage a deep understanding of technical product operation and business strategy to advise teams building products and features in a fast-paced, high-growth setting.  Work Autonomously: Serve as principal legal advisor to various ads product areas, and develop subject-matter expertise to lead cross-product initiatives.  Guide Strategy: Develop principles and frameworks that will help teams design products for a changing regulatory environment. Counsel Emerging Technologies: Advise on cutting-edge technology, including AI-driven features, data-clean-room solutions, and advanced machine learning.  Engage Across Functions: Work closely with product managers, engineers, business partners, and other functions and all levels of the company.  Data & Privacy Governance: Ensure that products and features comply with evolving global privacy and data laws (GDPR, ePrivacy, U.S. State Laws) and internal policies. What We’re Looking For: Advertising Expertise: 10+ years of legal experience with a significant focus on online advertising. You understand the digital ads business and the information systems and data flows that support it. Experience as ads product counsel at a UGC platform is a plus.  Good Team Member: A nimble, creative thinker with lots of positive energy, superior organizational skills, a growth mindset, strong attention to detail, a sense of humor, and a team-first attitude.  Technical Understanding: Deep knowledge of technical ads infrastructure and emerging trends. Experience advising AI-feature development in ads is a plus. Problem Solver: A "get-to-yes" mindset. Enthusiastic collaboration with the business to find workable solutions and drive risk-based decisionmaking. Clear, Concise Communication: Someone who can process information quickly, confidently exercise judgment in a timely fashion, and succinctly summarize complex legal concepts in writing or in conversation.  Project Management: Ability to lead cross-functional groups and drive successful, timely outcomes in projects while balancing other tasks and responsibilities.  Mastery of the Regulatory Landscape: Strong working knowledge of privacy laws and regulations, including the GDPR, U.S. State Privacy Laws, and self-regulatory regimes (IAB, NAI), as well as other statutory regimes that impact ads platforms (e.g., DSA, the EU AI Act).  Qualifications : JD and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar (or ability to register as in-house counsel where required). Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave  Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. title: Product Counsel
description: Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We are hiring an experienced Product Counsel to join our Legal team. As Product Counsel, you will work with teams across the business including product, engineering, data science, marketing, compliance, and sales, to develop a deep understanding of Toast’s products, platform, and AI-driven strategies, and to offer pragmatic legal advice that helps the business identify and mitigate legal risk. This role leans technical. You will partner closely with the teams building the foundations of the Toast platform as well as the products built on top of them, including our Enterprise offerings. The best candidate for this role finds the technical detail interesting rather than an obstacle. Toast’s product portfolio evolves quickly, and so does this role. We are looking for someone agile who can shift priorities with the business. Our Legal & Compliance teams are primarily concentrated in Boston, New York, Washington D.C., San Francisco, and Chicago. Candidates residing in these areas will be prioritized, as they will benefit from closer proximity to colleagues and greater access to company resources and events.   A Day in the Life (Responsibilities) Advising a variety of stakeholders across the product, engineering, data, and marketing teams throughout the product development lifecycle — from the initial stages of product development through launch, including the review of marketing strategies and assets. Providing practical advice to business stakeholders on a broad range of issues including regulatory compliance, consumer protection, intellectual property, artificial intelligence, marketing, and privacy. Advising on the design and deployment of core platform infrastructure and the AI built on top of it, including platform and API design, integrations, and the questions raised when an AI system takes action on a customer’s behalf. Counseling product, engineering, and data science teams across the machine learning model lifecycle. Advising on identity, authentication, authorization, and account security, including consent, delegated access, and the legal requirements that shape access-control design. Translating legal requirements into technical requirements, writing guidance engineers can build against, and reviewing design documents, data models, and architecture proposals. Understanding and staying up to date on U.S. and international laws and regulations relating to the Toast platform, including the shifting global AI legal landscape. Thinking creatively to navigate complex regulatory environments to ensure a smooth and compliant user experience. Helping build scalable and effective processes such as playbooks, intake triage, decision trees, so routine questions resolve quickly and hard questions reach you early. Partnering collaboratively across privacy, security, compliance, and fellow product counsel on issues that cross team lines.   What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) A J.D. from an ABA-accredited U.S. law school, and membership in good standing in at least one state bar. 5+ years of legal experience in areas covering regulatory compliance, privacy, intellectual property, and consumer protection. In-house legal department experience advising product, engineering, and marketing teams on issues related to the development of new products, product enhancements, and feature requests. Technical fluency. You are comfortable reading architecture and design documentation, reasoning about data flows, schemas, APIs, and model behavior, and engaging engineers and data scientists as a peer. A computer science degree is not required; the ability to do the work is. Experience with AI or machine learning issues — training data rights, model governance, or emerging AI regulation — and the judgment to advise on novel questions without settled precedent. Experience with data-use and data-rights questions: what a company may do with the data it holds, and how aggregation, de-identification, and contractual commitments change the answer. Experience working with fast-paced technology or software companies. Exceptional communication skills and the ability to explain complex ideas in a succinct and impactful manner. A solution-oriented, customer service, and growth mindset. The ability to integrate into cross-functional teams with a cooperative and participatory approach.   AI at Toast At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them.
